description: Shows CodeI18n comment translations from the project's .codei18n cache (read-only).
command.toggleSideView: Open CodeI18n Translation View to the Side
config.language: Display language, e.g. zh-CN, zh-TW, ja. Leave empty to follow the project's .codei18n configuration.
config.ghostText.enabled: In ghost display mode, show translations as ghost text at the end of the comment's last line.
config.ghostText.maxLength: Maximum number of characters of ghost text; longer or multi-line translations are cut with '…'.
config.hover.enabled: Show the full translation when hovering a translated comment.
config.display: Where translations are shown in the editor.
config.display.ghost: Ghost text at the end of the comment's last line.
config.display.replace: Replace the comment text with the translation. Lines touched by the cursor show the original comment. The file itself is never changed.
color.replaceForeground: Color of translations that replace comments (display mode 'replace').
